# AgentX
> The autonomous AI agent that builds production-ready websites from your terminal.

## Core Reference
- Package: @agent-qofeno/agentx-cli
- Version: v2.1.0
- Homebrew: brew tap SohailKhan0525/agentx && brew install agentx
- JSR: jsr:@agent-qofeno/agentx-cli
- GitHub: https://github.com/SohailKhan0525/agentx-cli
- Documentation: https://sohailkhan0525.github.io/agentx-docs/

## Workflow
1. Plan: Structured requirement decomposition
2. Read: Inspect existing files before editing
3. Tools: Execute real shell commands and file operations
4. Iterate: Automated TypeScript and build validation loops
5. Ship: Deploy production websites to Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare, GitHub Pages
